plans.name: Optima Secure
highlights: Secure Benefit: base SI doubled from day 1
Plus Benefit: +50% SI per year up to +100%, irrespective of claims
Protect Benefit: listed non-payable items paid
Restore: 100% of base SI restored on partial or complete use

citation.quote: Room rent limit shall be ‘At Actuals’ unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.

room_rent_limit.note: The Annexure C plan chart shows 'At Actuals' for the Optima Secure plan. An optional modification caps it at a Single Private Room (subject to underwriting). Other plans under the same UIN differ: Optima Lite caps rent at 1% of SI and Optima Select at a single private room.

citation.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.

initial_waiting_days.note: Accidents are exempt. Waived if the person has had continuous cover for more than 12 months.

citation.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.

Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.

ped_waiting_months.note: Unless the schedule says otherwise. The CIS lists 36/24/12 months, depending on the optional PED wait modification.

citation.quote: On availing this option, Pre-existing Disease Waiting Period shall stand modified and will be as stipulated in the Policy Schedule.

ped_waiting_reducible.note: The optional 'PED wait period modification' cuts the wait from 36 to 24 or 12 months. It can only be opted at channel level at inception, and the wording says individual policyholders cannot opt for it themselves.

citation.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.

pre_hosp_days.note: The Annexure C plan chart shows 60 days for Optima Secure (Optima Lite has 30).

citation.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.

post_hosp_days.note: The Annexure C plan chart shows 180 days for Optima Secure (Optima Lite has 60).

citation.quote: Optima Secure does not impose a co-payment clause

The company shall instantly add 100% of the Base Sum Insured under this benefit in the event of an admissible claim during the Policy Year due to which Sum Insured was partially or completely exhausted.

restoration_trigger.note: The restored amount is only for later claims in the same year.

citation.quote: On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 50% of the Base Sum Insured under the expiring Policy will be added to the Sum Insured available under the Renewed Policy subject to the following conditions:

ncb_pct_per_year.note: This is the 'Plus Benefit', built into Optima Secure and accrued regardless of claims. The Cumulative Bonus clause (10%) does not apply to this plan. Separately, the Secure Benefit adds 100% of Base SI from day 1.

citation.quote: The applicable Plus Benefit under this Cover can only be accumulated up to 100% of Base Sum Insured, and will be applicable only to the Insured Person covered under the expiring Policy and who continues to remain insured on Renewal.
This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.

ncb_reduces_on_claim.note: The Plus Benefit accrues regardless of claims.

citation.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Insured Person for the Non-Medical Expenses listed under Annexure B to this Policy incurred in relation to a claim admissible as per Section B-1

consumables_covered.note: This is the Protect Benefit, which covers the Annexure B non-medical items (gloves, masks and so on). Annexure C shows it as default-covered up to SI for Optima Secure, removable as an option.

citation.quote: There is no maximum cover ceasing age on renewals.

lifelong_renewal.note: Renewal is not denied except for established fraud, non-disclosure or misrepresentation, or if the product is withdrawn.

citation.quote: The Company upon getting cashless request form and related medical information from the Insured Person/ Network Provider shall issue pre-authorization letter to the Network Provider after verification.

in_house_claims.note: Inferred from the claims procedure. The Company itself receives intimation, issues pre-authorisation and takes reimbursement documents. No TPA is named anywhere in the documents.

citation.quote: Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by the Insurer and disclosed in its website/notified to the Policyholders are not admissible.

excluded_hospitals_list.note: In life-threatening situations or after an accident, expenses up to stabilisation are paid. The CIS links to the excluded-hospital list on hdfcergo.com.

citation.quote: At least 48 hours prior to admission in Hospital in case of a planned Hospitalization or decision to avail treatment under Section B-1.2 (Home Health Care).

cashless_intimation_planned_hrs.note: Also applies to Home Health Care.

citation.quote: Within 24 hours from the date of emergency Hospitalization required or before the Insured Person’s discharge from Hospital, whichever is earlier.

emergency_intimation_hrs.note: Or before discharge, whichever is earlier. A delay may be condoned on merit if it was beyond the insured's control.

citation.quote: Within 30 days of date of discharge from Hospital.

reimbursement_doc_days.note: Applies to hospitalisation, day care and pre-hospitalisation bills. Post-hospitalisation bills are due within 15 days of completing post-hospitalisation treatment. A delay may be condoned on merit.

citation.quote: has at least 10 in-patient beds in towns having a population of less than 10,00,000 and at least 15 in-patient beds in all other places;

hospital_min_beds.note: 10 beds in towns under 10 lakh population and 15 elsewhere. An alternative is registration under the Clinical Establishments Act.

citation.quote: ICU limit (including ICCU) for bed charges shall be ‘At Actuals’ unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.

icu_limit.note: The Annexure C plan chart shows 'At Actuals' for Optima Secure. Only the Optima Lite plan caps ICU at 2% of SI.

citation.quote: If Policy Holder chooses a higher room category above the eligibility defined in Policy Schedule, then proportionate deduction will apply on the Associated Medical Expenses in addition to the difference in room rent.

proportionate_deduction.note: The clause is in the wording but only applies when the room exceeds the category or limit in the schedule. citation.quote: In Optima Secure plan, Optima Super Secure plan and Optima Secure + plan, customers may choose to be covered upto Single Private room while ICU / ICCU expenses shall be covered at Actuals.

room_category_upgrade_rider.note: Not needed, because room rent is At Actuals by default. The only room option for Optima Secure is a restriction to a Single Private Room, not a waiver.

citation.quote: No co-payment shall apply if Insured Person from a lower tier avails a treatment in higher tier.

zone_copay_pct.note: Premium is tiered by city of residence (Tier 1 to 6), but there is no co-pay for treatment in a costlier tier.

citation.quote: The Insured agrees to bear a self-opted amount known as ‘Aggregate Deductible’ once during each Policy Year post which the Insurer’s liability under the Policy shall commence for that Policy Year.

deductible_amount.note: There is no mandatory deductible. An optional annual Aggregate Deductible (Rs 10,000 to Rs 25 lakh) can be chosen for a premium discount. Choosing Rs 10 lakh or more removes Secure, Plus, Restore, Daily Cash and the health check-up.

citation.quote: as long as these are no more than would have been payable if the Insured Person had not been insured and no more than other hospitals or doctors in the same locality would have charged for the same medical treatment.

citation.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred by the Insured Person on availing treatment at Home during the Policy Year, if prescribed in writing by the treating Medical Practitioner, provided that:

pricing_rules: p50: Premium Tier (Section 14): premium is computed on the city of residence given in the Proposal Form. Tier 1: Delhi, Surat, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida. Tier 2: Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Vadodara. Tier 3: Nashik, Rest of NCR, Amritsar, Ahmednagar, Mathura, Aligarh. Tier 4: Kolkata, Rest of Gujarat, Telangana, Agra, Ludhiana, Beed, Jalgaon, Indore, Gwalior. There is no co-payment when an insured person from a lower tier takes treatment in a higher tier.

p53: Family Floater premium (Section 16): the eldest member of the family pays the full individual premium for his/her age. A flat 55% floater discount then applies to the individual premiums of every other member.
p54: Floater discount: flat 55% on the individual premiums of every additional member other than the eldest (continuation of Section 16).
p29: Online Discount: 5% on premium when the policy is bought online (company website, app or digital platforms). It continues on renewals while no agent or intermediary is involved.
p29: Employee Discount: 5% when an insured person is a full-time HDFC Group or Munich Re Group employee and buys through the website or app with no intermediary.
p29: Loyalty Discount: 2.5% on the policy premium when an insured person holds an active retail policy with the Company whose premium is above Rs. 2,000.
p29: Family Discount: 10% on premium when two or more family members are covered under the same policy on the individual policy option.
p29: The Employee, Online, Loyalty and Family discounts are cumulative, but together they may not exceed 20%.
p29: Long Term Policy Discount: 6% for a 2-year, 8% for a 3-year, 8% for a 4-year and 8% for a 5-year policy tenure, when the premium is paid in advance as a single premium.
p29: NRI Discount: 40% for an insured person who declares they live abroad for the whole Policy Year, subject to conditions.
p30: Discount in lieu of Commission: up to 20% of the policy premium in exchange for lower commission.

p30: Lifetime Discount: 5% on the base premium when all insured persons are buying retail health insurance for the first time. It applies only to fresh new business (not portability or migration) and only when all insured persons are aged 35 or below at inception. It then continues for life on renewals.

p30: Aggregate Deductible Discount for Optima Secure (column 'Optima Suraksha, Optima Secure, Optima Super Secure, Optima Select, Optima Lite & Optima Secure +'), when the deductible is opted for all insured persons. Discount by deductible amount, in the order Base SI <25L / Base SI = 25L / Base SI = 50L, 100L or 200L: 10,000: 7%/5%/5%; 25,000: 22.5%/15%/15%; 50,000: 40%/30%/30%; 1,00,000: 50%/40%/40%; 2,00,000: 55%/45%/45%; 3,00,000: 65%/55%/55%; 5,00,000: NA/62%/62%; 10,00,000: NA/80.45%/80.45%; 20,00,000: NA/NA/88%; 25,00,000: NA/NA/90%.

p51: Favourable Claims Experience Discount for new buyers with no claim history (all plans except Optima Secure Global Plus): 21% in policy year 1, 18% in year 2, then 10% in years 3, 4 and 5 (Global Plus: 5.25%/4.50%/2.50%/2.50%/2.50%).

p51: Favourable Claims Experience Discount when all insured persons have exactly 1 prior policy year (all plans except Global Plus). With a claim in the last policy year: 11% in year 1, then 6% in each later year. With no claim in the last policy year: 18% in year 1, then 10% in each later year.

p52: Favourable Claims Experience Discount when any insured person has 2 or more prior policy years (all plans except Global Plus): 0% with claims in both the last year and the year before it; 6% with a claim in either one of those years; 10% with no claim in either year. The rate applies to every policy year.
p53: An insured person aged 60 or above at the start of a policy year is not eligible for the Favourable Claims Experience Discount for that year.

proportionate_deduction.note: The clause exists (4.21, and 6.2.4(d) has the formula), but in the base plan any room is allowed, so it does not bite. It applies only if the optional Room Type Modification (single private or sharing room) is chosen and a higher room is taken.

citation.quote: You may choose between a Single Private Room and a Sharing Room based on your needs.

room_category_upgrade_rider.note: No room-rent waiver add-on is offered, and none is needed because the base plan has no room cap. The only room option (Room Type Modification) narrows the room category; it does not remove a cap.

citation.quote: For the purpose of calculating premium, the country has been divided into the following 2 zones:

zone_copay_pct.note: The zones (Zone 1: Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Kolkata, Gujarat; Zone 2: rest of India) set the premium only. The wording has no zone-based co-pay clause.

citation.quote: Cataract: We will pay only for Mono-focal Lens for Sum Insured up to 10 lacs.

disease_sublimits.note: No fixed rupee caps on listed diseases or procedures. The only disease-specific limit: for Sum Insured up to 10 lakh, cataract is paid only with a mono-focal lens.

citation.quote: Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’.

consumables_covered.note: The base plan does not pay Annexure I non-payables. Optional add-on available: Safeguard covers List I and Safeguard+ covers Lists I-IV, at extra premium.

citation.quote: Costs which are not Reasonable and Customary and treatments which are not Medically Necessary.

reasonable_customary_clause.note: Specific exclusion 5.2.6. Reasonable and Customary charges are set using the tariff agreed with Network Providers (definition 2.1.38).

citation.quote: That is/are diagnosed by a physician not more than 36 months prior to the date of commencement of the policy issued by the insurer
Surgical treatment for diseases of middle ear and mastoid (including otitis media, cholesteatoma, perforation of tympanic membrane), Tonsils and adenoids, nasal septum and nasal sinuses

specific_disease_list_size.note: 11 numbered groups (i to xi); the quote is the last item, xi. Each group covers several conditions, for example vii covers osteoarthritis, joint replacement, gout and disc disorders.

citation.quote: The period of sixty continuous months is called as moratorium period.

The policyholder is entitled to transfer the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured, No Claim Bonus, specific waiting periods, waiting period for pre-existing disease, Moratorium period etc. from the Existing Insurer to the Acquiring Insurer in the previous policy.
Admitted for 2 hours or more (minimum 24 hours for AYUSH treatment in a AYUSH Hospital)

day_care_all.note: There is no day-care list. Any admission of 2 hours or more with active treatment is covered (24 hours for AYUSH).

citation.quote: Admitted for 2 hours or more (minimum 24 hours for AYUSH treatment in a AYUSH Hospital)

min_hospitalisation_hrs.note: The benefit clause allows 2 hours; AYUSH needs 24 hours. The generic Hospitalisation definition (2.1.17) still says 24 hours except for specified procedures.

citation.quote: Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home which in normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home provided that:

home_care_treatment.note: Requires a doctor's advice and daily monitoring records. Peritoneal dialysis and chemotherapy at home are covered.

citation.quote: Medical Expenses for in-patient Hospitalization incurred on treatment under Ayurveda, Yoga, and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy systems of medicines in an AYUSH Hospital is payable up to the sum assured as specified in the policy schedule.

ayush_covered.note: Must be in an AYUSH Hospital with at least 24 hours of admission. Yoga and Naturopathy claims need prior approval.

citation.quote: Road Ambulance: We will pay you up to Sum Insured.

road_ambulance_limit.note: There is no separate rupee cap: road ambulance is covered up to the Sum Insured. 500000 is the lowest Base SI option (5 lakh); the real limit equals the policy's SI. Paid only if the hospitalisation claim is paid.

citation.quote: Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. Maximum INR 2,50,000 per hospitalization.

air_ambulance.note: Emergency only, maximum INR 2,50,000 per hospitalisation. Paid only if the hospitalisation claim is paid.

citation.quote: If you ever undergo an organ transplant, we will pay the hospitalization expenses of the donor for harvesting the organ, ONLY when your Hospitalisation claim is paid.

organ_donor.note: Covered up to Sum Insured (benefit table).

citation.quote: Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during Hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy;

maternity_covered.note: Excluded under standard exclusion Code-Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is not excluded. No maternity add-on is offered.

citation.quote: You can take Unlimited e-consultations from our Partners.

opd_cover.note: The only outpatient-type benefit is unlimited e-consultations with network partners. There is no OPD consultation or pharmacy reimbursement.

citation.quote: Available once every Policy Year, from day 1 of the policy.

annual_health_checkup.note: From day 1, no claim-free condition. Worth INR 500 per lakh of Base SI, up to INR 5,000 per insured (individual) or INR 10,000 per policy (floater). Cashless only, booked through the app.

citation.quote: Once in a Policy year, you can choose to take a second medical opinion from any Medical Practitioner for which we have paid a claim under expenses during hospitalization.

second_opinion.note: Once per policy year, only for a condition for which a hospitalisation claim was paid.

citation.quote: This Policy covers Allopathic and AYUSH treatments taken in India ONLY.
We will pay for an Insured, an additional fixed amount for each day’s hospitalization for maximum up to 30 days.

daily_hospital_cash.note: Hospital Cash is an optional benefit (INR 1,000-4,000 per day by SI, needs 48 hours or more of hospitalisation, max 30 days). Optional add-on available. Separately, the base plan pays Shared Accommodation Cash (INR 800-1,000 per day) only if you take a shared room.

citation.quote: Maximum amount ReAssure+ pays for any single claim is up to Base Sum Insured.

restoration_same_member.note: No member or illness restriction is stated for ReAssure+. The only limit is the per-claim cap at Base SI.

citation.quote: Unutilized Base Sum Insured carries forward. Maximum it will accumulate up to 3/5/10 times (based on the plan you have chosen) of the Base Sum Insured.

ncb_pct_per_year.note: Booster+ is not a fixed percentage: it carries forward the unused Base SI. A claim-free year adds 100% of Base SI (wording example: 10L base becomes 1 Cr Booster+ over 10 claim-free years). Platinum+ cap is 5x.

citation.quote: We will never ask for more than 100% for any particular health condition and never more than 150% for any individual.

premium_loading_for_ped.note: Risk loading after underwriting, up to 100% per condition and 150% per person. It continues at renewals.

citation.quote: Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports,

adventure_sports_excluded.note: Excluded only when taking part as a professional (Code-Excl09).

citation.quote: Treatment for, alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof.
Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil all the below conditions:

obesity_treatment_conditions.note: Conditions: doctor's advice, clinical protocols, age 18+, and BMI of 40+ (or 35+ with listed severe comorbidities after less invasive methods have failed).

citation.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded.

investigation_only_excluded.note: Code-Excl04. Section 4.2.1 adds that a stay with only investigations is not paid, but invasive angiography is paid.

citation.quote: Expenses related to sterility and infertility. This includes:

infertility_covered.note: Code-Excl17, which includes IVF and other assisted reproduction.

citation.quote: Get 15% discount on Premium. A co-payment of 20% would apply if treatment taken

non_network_copay_pct.note: The base plan has no co-pay for non-network hospitals, and the wording offers 'Cashless Everywhere' even outside the network. A 20% co-pay applies only if you choose the optional Tiered Network rider (UIN NBHHLIA25039V012425, 15% premium discount) and are then treated in a non-Tiered Network hospital. Optional add-on available.

citation.quote: Annual Aggregate Deductible Small deductibles to choose from. INR 20,000; INR 30,000; INR 50,000; INR 1,00,000

deductible_amount.note: No mandatory deductible. An optional Annual Aggregate Deductible is available: the brochure lists INR 20k/30k/50k/1L and the prospectus also lists INR 10,000. Optional add-on available.

citation.quote: Home Care/Domiciliary Covered up to Sum Insured.

domiciliary.note: One combined Home Care/Domiciliary benefit (wording 4.4). Medical and ambulatory devices used at home are not paid.

citation.quote: 5X: Unutilised Base Sum Insured carries forward

ncb_max_pct.note: Platinum+ value: Booster+ up to 5 times Base SI. Other variants: Diamond+/Bronze+ 3x, Titanium+/Gold+ 10x.

citation.quote: Co-payment Options of 20% / 30% / 40% / 50%

general_copay_pct.note: No mandatory co-pay. A voluntary co-pay of 20/30/40/50% is listed under Optional Benefits. Optional add-on available.

citation.quote: Co-payment Options of 20% / 30% / 40% / 50%

age_copay_pct.note: The wording has no age-based co-pay. The only co-pay in the documents is the voluntary optional one (20-50%).

citation.quote: The minimum entry age for adult is 18 years and for dependent child is 91 days.

newborn_day1.note: Inferred: the documents have no newborn cover clause, maternity is excluded, and a dependent child can enter only from 91 days.

citation.quote: The maximum entry age limit for adults in this product is 99 years.

max_entry_age.note: Adults up to 99; dependent children up to 30 (minimum 91 days).

citation.quote: A discount will be applied at new business only, for those policies that are new to health insurance (excludes policies that come as port, migration and renewals).

portability_in.note: The prospectus mentions policies that come in as ports, and wording 6.1.13 provides for portability between insurers.

ncb_pct_per_year.note: Optional add-ons available: Cumulative Bonus Super adds 100%/yr up to 500%; the Care Advanced booster adds 100%/yr with no cap.

citation.quote: Sum Insured (excluding Cumulative Bonus) shall be increased by 50%, provided the policy is renewed without a break subject to maximum 100% of the sum Insured.

ncb_max_pct.note: Optional add-ons available: Cumulative Bonus Super (max 500%) and the Cumulative Bonus Booster under Care Advanced.

citation.quote: Cumulative Bonus 50% of SI per year, max up to 100% of SI; Note: Shall not reduce in case of claim

ncb_reduces_on_claim.note: The schedule says the bonus does not reduce on a claim. The benefit text says it builds up for years of 'un-interrupted good health' if renewed without a break.

citation.quote: If, due to claims made, you ever utilize the maximum limit of Sum Insured and thereby run out of/exhaust your health cover, we reinstate the entire base sum insured immediately, for unlimited times in the policy year.

restoration_trigger.note: The recharge is drawn last, after SI, Plus Benefit, Cumulative Bonus and CB Super. The recharge is not listed in the single-claim maximum (general condition 3.II).

citation.quote: We cover the medically necessary expenses (Up to Sum Insured) incurred by You for a period of 60 days immediately before the date of Your admissible Hospitalization

option to ... choose for co-payment option of 20% per claim ... and thereby get a discount of 20% in Premium

plans.name: Health Guard
highlights: Cheaper variant with a 1%-of-SI room cap
Sold only at Rs 1.5L or Rs 2L cover (insurer premium chart). A 1% room cap at Rs 2L is Rs 2,000/day.

citation.quote: Up to 1% of Sum Insured per day (Excluding Cumulative Bonus).

In case of admission to a room at rates exceeding the limits as mentioned under (i), the reimbursement of all other expenses incurred at the Hospital, with the exception of cost of Pharmacy/medicines, consumables, implants, medical devices & diagnostics, shall be payable in the same proportion

proportionate_deduction.note: Applies where a room cap exists (Silver; Gold SI 3-7.5 lakh). Pharmacy, consumables, implants, devices and diagnostics are exempt. Not applied in hospitals without differential billing.

citation.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Health Guard Policy with us.

ncb_pct_per_year.note: Cumulative Bonus for Silver and Gold.

citation.quote: If a claim is made in any year where a cumulative increase has been applied, then the increased Limit of Indemnity in the Policy Period of the subsequent “Health Guard” shall be reduced by 10%

ncb_reduces_on_claim.note: Reduced by 10% for each year with a claim; the base SI of the first policy is preserved.

citation.quote: Under normal circumstances, lifetime renewal benefit is available under the policy

lifelong_renewal.note: The policy wording says the policy is renewable except on grounds of established fraud, non-disclosure or misrepresentation, provided the product is not withdrawn.

citation.quote: All Claims will be settled by In-house claims settlement team of the Company and no TPA is engaged.

in_house_claims.note: The company reserves the right to engage a TPA at any time at its sole discretion.

citation.quote: Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by the Insurer and disclosed in its website / notified to the policyholders are not admissible.

excluded_hospitals_list.note: Excl11. In life-threatening situations or after an accident, expenses up to stabilisation are payable. The CIS also links a 'Black listed hospital list'.

citation.quote: In case of Planned hospitalization, You/the Insured Person/ Insured’s representative shall intimate such admission before 48 hours of such hospitalization.

cashless_intimation_planned_hrs.note: The same 48-hour advance intimation also applies to planned reimbursement claims.

citation.quote: In case of Emergency hospitalization, You/ Insured Person/ Insured’s representative shall intimate such admission within 24 hours of such hospitalization.

emergency_intimation_hrs.note: 24 hours applies to cashless claims. For reimbursement claims the wording allows intimation within 48 hours of an emergency hospitalisation.

citation.quote: You or someone claiming on Your behalf must promptly and in any event within 30 days of discharge from a Hospital give Us the documentation as listed out in greater detail below

reimbursement_doc_days.note: A waiver may be considered in cases of extreme hardship.

citation.quote: We offer Cashless Everywhere, even in hospitals which are not part of our network subject to hospitals fullfiing IRDAI definition of Hospital facility.

non_network_copay_pct.note: No non-network co-pay clause appears anywhere in the wording. The CIS co-payment table lists only voluntary and zone co-pays.

citation.quote: has at least 10 in-patient beds in towns having a population of less than 10,00,000 and at least 15 in-patient beds in all other places;

hospital_min_beds.note: 10 beds in towns with a population under 10 lakh; 15 beds elsewhere. Registration under the Clinical Establishments Act is an alternative to these criteria.

citation.quote: All Claims will be settled by In-house claims settlement team of the Company and no TPA is engaged.

tpa_name.note: The company reserves the right to engage a TPA at its discretion.

If opted voluntarily by You, You shall bear 10%/ 20% of co-payment for each and every claim payable under the In-patient Hospitalization Treatment section

general_copay_pct.note: No mandatory co-pay. A voluntary 10%/20% co-pay is available for a premium discount. A zone co-pay may apply separately.

citation.quote: We shall pay Reasonable & Customary Medical Expenses in respect of an admissible Hospitalization claim in excess of the Annual Aggregate Deductible limit of ₹ 50,000 / ₹ 100000 / ₹ 200000 / ₹ 300000, as opted by You

deductible_amount.note: No mandatory deductible. A voluntary annual aggregate deductible of Rs 50,000 / 1 lakh / 2 lakh / 3 lakh is optional.

citation.quote: Our obligation to make payment in respect of surgeries for cataracts (after the expiry of the 24 months period referred to in Exclusion 02) above, shall be restricted to 20% of the Sum Insured for each eye, subject to maximum of Rs 1,00,000/- for each of You.

disease_sublimits.note: The only procedure sub-limits are cataract and bariatric surgery.

notable_sublimits.value: Cataract 20% of SI per eye (max Rs 1 lakh); bariatric surgery 25% of SI (Silver) / 50% of SI max Rs 5 lakh (Gold); road ambulance Rs 20,000 per policy year; Gold maternity Rs 15k/25k (SI 3-7.5L) or Rs 25k/35k (SI above 7.5L); reinstatement for cancer and kidney failure only once in lifetime

citation.quote: shall be restricted to 25% of the Sum Insured in Silver Plan and 50% of the Sum Insured subject to maximum of Rs 5 lac in Gold and Platinum Plan.

notable_sublimits.note: The brochure's sub-limit table also shows Ayurvedic/Homeopathic hospitalisation at Rs 20,000 per policy year for Gold. This conflicts with the wording, which pays up to SI.

citation.quote: Our obligation to make payment in respect of surgeries for cataracts (after the expiry of the 24 months period referred to in Exclusion 02) above, shall be restricted to 20% of the Sum Insured for each eye, subject to maximum of Rs 1,00,000/- for each of You.

cataract_limit.note: 20% of SI per eye: Rs 30,000 at SI 1.5 lakh and Rs 40,000 at SI 2 lakh. These are computed from the 1.5L/2L Silver SI options.

citation.quote: Modern Treatment Methods and Advancement in Technologies (as per list in Annexure III) shall be covered up to Base Sum Insured, subject to Policy Terms, Conditions, coverages, Waiting Period and exclusions.

modern_treatment_limit_pct.note: Up to base SI for the 12 treatments listed in Annexure III.

citation.quote: All non-medical Items as per Annexure II.

consumables_covered.note: Annexure II non-medical items (gloves, masks, belts, etc.) are excluded, and the documents offer no consumables add-on. The brochure lists 'Medical Consumables' among in-patient expenses, but the policy wording does not.

Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident, provided the same are covered.

initial_waiting_days.note: Accidents are not subject to this waiting period.

citation.quote: If the Insured Person is continuously covered without any break as defined under the portability norms of the extant IRDAI (Health Insurance) Regulations then waiting period for the same would be reduced to the extent of prior coverage.

ped_waiting_reducible.note: Reduced only through portability credit for prior cover. The documents mention no add-on to buy down the PED waiting period.

citation.quote: That is/are diagnosed by a Physician not more than 36 months prior to the date of commencement of the policy issued by the insurer;

Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Health Guard Policy with Us.

specific_disease_waiting_months.note: 24 months for 27 listed conditions. citation.quote: 27. Alzheimer’s Disease

specific_disease_list_size.note: 27 conditions on the 24-month list, plus 9 more on a separate 36-month list (36 in total).

bariatric_waiting_months.note: Requires BMI >=40, or >=35 with listed co-morbidities, and age 18 or older.

waiting_credit_on_port.note: The same credit is stated for the specific-disease waiting period. Maternity credit applies only where the prior policy had maternity cover.

day_care_all.note: Day care is covered only for the procedures listed in Annexure I (about 400).

Medical Expenses where Inpatient care is not warranted and does not require supervision of qualified nursing staff and qualified Medical Practitioner round the clock.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is not one of the listed covers.

citation.quote: Medical Expenses where Inpatient care is not warranted and does not require supervision of qualified nursing staff and qualified Medical Practitioner round the clock.

home_care_treatment.note: No home care or hospital-at-home cover among the listed covers.

ayush_covered.note: Covers Ayurvedic and Homeopathic in-patient treatment (24h+) in a government or recognised/accredited AYUSH hospital. The brochure's Gold sub-limit table conflicts (shows Rs 20,000 per policy year).

road_ambulance_limit.note: The limit is per policy year, not per hospitalisation, and requires a certified life-threatening emergency.

air_ambulance.note: Not in the base cover. An optional add-on is available for SI Rs 5 lakh and above, so in practice only Gold qualifies (Silver SI is 1.5L/2L).

mental_health_parity.note: Limited to the ICD codes in Annexure IV. Mental Illness is on the 24-month specific waiting list.

citation.quote: Maternity (Excl18) (Applicable for Silver Plan only):

maternity_covered.note: Maternity is excluded under Silver, except ectopic pregnancy.

citation.quote: New Born Baby Cover (Applicable for Gold and Platinum Plan only):

newborn_day1.note: Silver has no newborn cover; dependent children can enter from 3 months.

citation.quote: Surgeries taken as an inpatient in a hospital or day care center but not in the outpatient department.

opd_cover.note: No OPD cover among the listed benefits.

citation.quote: At the end of block of every continuous period as mentioned in coverage during which You have held Our Health Guard Policy, You are eligible for a free Preventive Health checkup.

annual_health_checkup.note: Not annual: one preventive check-up per block of 3 continuous years. Gold pays 1% of SI up to Rs 5,000; Silver pays 1% of SI up to Rs 2,000.

citation.quote: Any treatment received outside India is not covered under this Policy.

We will pay Daily Cash Benefit of ₹ 500 per day maximum up to 10 days during each Policy Year for reasonable accommodation expenses in respect of one parent/ legal guardian, to stay with any minor Insured (under the Age of 12)

daily_hospital_cash.note: No general daily hospital cash. The only daily cash is Rs 500/day (max 10 days/year) for a parent staying with a hospitalised insured child under 12. A lump-sum convalescence benefit is paid for stays over 10 days.

citation.quote: This benefit is- applicable only once during each Policy Year and will not be carried forward to the subsequent Policy Year/renewals if the benefit is not utilized.

restoration_type.note: 100% of base SI is reinstated once per policy year. For Cancer and Kidney Failure requiring dialysis it applies only once in a lifetime.

citation.quote: The reinstated Sum Insured will be triggered only after the In-patient Hospitalization Treatment Sum Insured inclusive of the Cumulative Bonus or Super Cumulative Bonus (If applicable) has been completely exhausted during the Policy Year.

restoration_trigger.note: Does not apply to the claim that exhausts the SI, only to later claims.

citation.quote: however Sum Insured reinstatement would be triggered for subsequent claims for the same member or other insured members.

The Company may add a risk loading to the premium applicable for the person to be insured, based on the information provided in the proposal form and the health status of those person to be insured.

premium_loading_for_ped.note: Maximum risk loading is 200% per insured person, and it continues at renewals.

Expenses related to sterility and infertility.

Voluntary co-payment 10%/ 20% of admissible claim amount
